pivotkit-server: the server starts, but not everything will work.
1 problem, 2 warnings.

PROBLEM: sources.gone.file: data/missing.csv is not there -> the server
    starts; gone answers FILE_NOT_AVAILABLE

WARNING (Sources): sources.sales.policy: "show" by default with hidden fields
    is a deny list: a column the data gains later is shown unless someone
    hides it; prefer "hide" by default and give the fields to show the level
    show
WARNING (Auth): the token bot's scope "typo:scope" is named by no source, tool
    or required scope

Sources (3):
  no description: sales, gone, code (a model chooses sources by it:
      sources.<id>.description)
  values listed per shown field: 20 (policy.items)
  results inline in the tool answer: up to 500 cells (policy.inline)
  sales: a file
    <dir>/data/sales.csv
    policy: show by default; Customer hide
    scopes: sales:read
    a value kept back is safe in CSV only when values that hold the separator
        are quoted and no quoted value spans lines; xlsx or JSON is safer
    field levels (automatic values: not applied, a default is written):
      Region: show (the default)
      Product: show (the default)
      Customer: hide (a rule)
      Sales: show (the default)
  gone: a file
    <dir>/data/missing.csv
    policy: summary by default
    a value kept back is safe in CSV only when values that hold the separator
        are quoted and no quoted value spans lines; xlsx or JSON is safer
  code: a code source, described under Code sources
    policy: summary by default
    fields: known only after a load

Files by path: off

Code sources (1):
  code: load up to 30000 ms
    loaded on every call
    data per caller
    last good data: up to 3600 s after a transient failure

Kept loads: at most 256 MiB (sourceCache.maxMb)
  the data code and HTTP sources loaded, kept for their next calls
  a table over 64 MiB (a quarter) is not kept and loads on every call
  with several contexts in one process, the largest setting applies

Data in the request (inline:):
  MCP: on, up to 500 rows / 5000 cells / 256 KiB
  REST: off (no policy or profile has data: true)

Output: out
  <dir>/out
  at most 1000 files and 1024 MiB of pivotkit's; schedule drafts at most 500
      files and 512 MiB
  when full, the oldest reports are deleted to make room; drafts are kept
  reports older than 30 days are deleted; schedule drafts stay until a person
      approves or removes them

Delivery:
  download links: http://127.0.0.1:3333/downloads/<token>
    expire after 60 minutes
  closed for plain links: sales (Customer hide under default show: a column
      the data gains later would be shown), gone (fields summary by default),
      code (fields summary by default)
    for plain links, set the source's default to hide and list the fields to
        show
    for plain links, set the fields at values or summary to show, or set the
        default to hide and list the fields to show
  per person (counted as closed): data sent in requests (inline:)
  reports over closed sources (sales, gone, code): no links (the file is kept;
      the person asks you for it)
    set output.downloads.signIn for links only the person can open

HTTP: 127.0.0.1:3333
  connections per address: at most 32 (the default; clients reach the server
      directly)

Auth: token
  token bot from $BOT_TOKEN: scopes sales:read typo:scope, profile analyst

Profile analyst:
  policy: show by default
  file downloads (REST): allowed
  sales: Region show, Product show, Customer hide, Sales show
  code: fields known only after a load; show by default

REST: /api/v1
  CORS: https://app.example.com
  /openapi.json: needs auth

Log:
  level info, format auto (text on a terminal, JSON otherwise)
  addresses on: the socket's peer

New in this version:
  schedule drafts take at most half of output.maxMb (output.draftMaxAgeDays
      lets waiting drafts expire)
    -> https://pivotkit.eize.dev/getting-started/upgrading/#draft-quota
  inline csv and json results round numbers as the view shows them; report
      files and drafts are named in lower case without spaces
    -> https://pivotkit.eize.dev/getting-started/upgrading/#results-0-8
